Create ONE clean transparent PNG containing THREE matched horizontal logo lockups, arranged vertically with generous transparent space between them. Brand: EMMA, Emergency Management Assistant. Kentucky civil-defence beta repurposed by survivors to manage their camp. Thoughtful visual idea: a simple sturdy house/roof shelter combined with a modest radio mast and two short signal arcs, framed by an understated round civil-defence-style badge. The icon should communicate a home that is still transmitting. Original composition; no existing government seal, no franchise symbols, no skulls, no weapons, no copied Fallout or Portal art.
To the right of the badge, bold condensed monospaced lettering reading exactly "EMMA". Below it, smaller but readable lettering exactly "CAMP SYSTEM". A tiny second line may read "KENTUCKY • 1993" only if it remains clean and readable.
Make the badge and wordmark feel like a fictional county contractor's 1993 monochrome computer boot emblem: crisp geometric linework, simple strong silhouette, deliberate pixel-grid character, restrained 16-bit terminal aesthetic, lightly imperfect screen-print edges. Practical and slightly austere. No cute mascot, modern app gradients, bevels, 3D, chrome or elaborate ornamental detail.

entries.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Edit the provided fictional Project Zomboid FOSSOIL logo into a transparent 1993 computer boot/header logo for an in-game CRT terminal. The image is the EDIT TARGET, preserve its recognizable long-necked dinosaur silhouette, exact uppercase word FOSSOIL, and recognizable periwinkle blue / warm ivory / small orange brand palette. Redesign the composition into one compact horizontal lockup: the dinosaur icon at left, FOSSOIL wordmark at right, subtle thin orange line below the name. IMPORTANT: completely remove the large solid blue rounded rectangle and the solid blue wordmark banner; no sign panel, no box, no filled background, no separate sticker backing. Dinosaur and name should be isolated glowing marks sitting directly on genuinely transparent alpha, ready to draw over near-black terminal glass. Use restrained blue outlines or sparse blue accents, soft ivory for the main dinosaur silhouette and letters, one small amber-orange accent rule. Clean chunky pixel-grid edges, low-resolution bitmap boot-logo aesthetic, crisp readable uppercase lettering, limited flat colours, slight period-appropriate pixel stepping. No photo, no illustration scene, no CRT monitor, no background gradients, no heavy baked glow, no shadows, no decorative stars, no extra words or slogans. Preserve corporate identity, make it feel rendered by a 1993 business computer instead of showing a petrol station sign. ONE horizontal logo only, roughly 4:1 aspect ratio with very tight transparent margins. The final thumbnail will display around 220 by 55 pixels. Keep the brand colours visible, not monochrome.
